source_authority: Direct player actions and dialogue have priority over GM assumptions
scene_location: Konoha main Chunin exam arena, Shiki vs Gaara semifinal
player_action: Shiki walks onto arena, says verbatim: «Я помню твой вопрос. Отвечу: я существую всегда.» Then raises a hand and declares «сдаюсь» immediately before battle. No attacks, preparations, explanations or later action by Shiki.
prior_gaara_question: Exact played session 1 source: Gaara asked Shiki in tower cafeteria «Когда ты убиваешь человека, ты чувствуешь, что существуешь?» This is what Shiki answers. Do NOT substitute «зачем ты существуешь» or «ради чего» as if it were original question. His answer asserts constant existence not conditioned on killing, in Gaara's frame.
gm_decision: Genma accepts unmistakable forfeiture, Gaara advances to final without a fight at 11:09. Gaara is disturbed and angered, sand begins to advance until Genma intervenes and warns that further movement toward Shiki would lead to disqualification. Gaara retracts sand; no damage/attack to Shiki, player is still on arena and may decide next action. Byes and semifinals fixed; other semifinal Neji vs Sasuke still pending.
correction: In assistant-visible scene, last Gaara dialogue incorrectly paraphrased earlier question as «Я спрашивал... ради чего». This is RETCONNED. Corrected Gaara response: «Я спросил, чувствуешь ли ты, что существуешь, когда убиваешь. А ты говоришь — всегда? Даже не убивая?» Keep this exact question as source continuity.
